c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.title: Runtime Analysis and Asymptotics in C
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.description: A private, animation-supported C course that turns loop traces and recursive call chains into exact execution counts, limit comparisons, growth ordering, and formal O, Ω, and Θ proofs.
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.moreComingSoon: This course is complete: frequency counting, limit comparisons, inequality proofs, and the cumulative C capstone are all included.

c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.title: Frequency Counting in C
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.description: Trace loops and recursion, derive exact execution counts, and simplify them to tight asymptotic bounds.
outcomes: Use the frequency-count method on C loops and recursive calls.
Distinguish constant, rectangular, triangular, cubic, sequential, and recursive patterns.
Report both exact statement counts and tight Θ bounds.
why: The recitation begins with concrete C fragments, so the course starts by making every iteration visible.
Animations turn each output shape into the sum or product that determines the runtime.

c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.title: Asymptotics with Limits
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.description: Compare functions by evaluating the limiting ratio f(n)/g(n), then order common growth classes.
outcomes: Interpret ratio limits of 0, a positive constant, and infinity.
Classify polynomial, logarithmic, and exponential pairs.
Order standard growth functions from logarithmic through factorial.
why: Limit comparisons provide a repeatable bridge from algebra to O, Ω, and Θ.
The module preserves the handout’s worked pairs while making the standard ratio rule explicit.

c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.title: Proofs from the Definitions
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.description: Choose constants and thresholds that prove Big-O, Big-Ω, and Big-Θ statements.
outcomes: Write the required inequality before choosing constants.
Find valid c, c1, c2, and n0 values.
Explain why finite prefixes do not affect asymptotic classes.
why: The handout ends with formal proofs, so learners move from observed growth to definition-level justification.
Each proof follows the same visible recipe: choose constants, solve the inequality, test the threshold, conclude.

c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.title: Runtime Analysis Capstone
c--c-runtime-analysis-asymptotics--draft.description: Apply tracing, exact counting, asymptotic classification, and inequality bounds in one cumulative C project.
outcomes: Analyze unfamiliar C fragments without relying on memorized labels.
Connect exact formulas to Θ classifications.
Verify a proposed Θ bound with explicit constants.
why: The capstone combines the entire course method in a compact multi-step workspace.
Learners finish with reusable analysis functions rather than isolated multiple-choice answers.
